title: My School Life Pretending To Be a Worthless Person
altTitles: Giả Vờ Làm Kẻ Vô Dụng ở Học Đường
隠れS級覚醒者の学園生活
Mi vida escolar pretendiendo ser una persona inútil
description: In a world where humanity has learned to materialize the essence of the human soul, Edeya, a person's rank determines their combat power and social standing. Park Jinsung appears to be an F-rank student with an insignificant soul, making him an easy target for contempt and bullying. In reality, however, he possesses an S-rank Edeya called Absolute Killing Intent. Troubled by the violent nature of his power, Jinsung deliberately hides his true ability and continues pretending to be worthless while struggling to control his murderous instincts.
author: Ppilippala
